name: L2P
description: L2P (Latent-to-Pixel) is an efficient transfer paradigm for pixel-space diffusion models that discards VAEs and utilizes large-patch tokenization to achieve native 4K/8K/10K ultra-high resolution image generation.
keyFeatures: VAE-Free Architecture: Replaces traditional VAEs with large-patch tokenization to eliminate memory bottlenecks and compression artifacts
Generative Prior Transfer: Freezes pre-trained LDM intermediate layers and trains shallow layers with a Detailer Head to map latent priors to pixel space
Synthetic Training Corpus: Efficiently converges using LDM-generated synthetic data without requiring real-world image datasets
Native 4K/8K/10K Resolution: Direct pixel generation supporting ultra-high resolution synthesis with minimal computational overhead
curatorNotes: Verified research project by Nanjing University (NJU-PCALab) and Tencent Youtu Lab.
